name: Spider arm
description: One jointed arm of the spider hand, rooted at the origin and reaching out along +x: a femur up to a raised knee, a tibia back down to the claw, and the claw split into a pair of fangs. Every plate the weapon owns composes this — the slot icon fans three of them off one knuckle, Eighth Leg fans four, Hauling Arms mirrors two of them inward — so the arm is drawn once and the finds are arrangements of it. Bones darken outward from the body the way the Scolopend's fringe does, which is depth rather than light: a limb the parent turns to any angle cannot carry a lit edge without the light turning with it. The weapon's own arms on the field are geometry solved per frame against a live target, so this is the same animal in a pose rather than the sprite that is drawn there.

evolved.description: Widow's Grip: the same arm in the amber every evolved weapon in the roster wears, claws gilded.
